units.source_text: 阿笑从马车里一跳出来，就马上瑟缩着脖颈，一溜烟跑进山茶林里，穿过浓密的树荫向竹林奔去。

en.t: As soon as A-Shao jumped down from the carriage, she immediately hunched her neck against the cold and dashed into the camellia grove, running through the dense shade toward the bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 然后从怀里掏出一瓶酒，嘴对瓶口喝了起来。

en.t: Then she pulled a bottle of liquor from inside her clothes, put her mouth to the opening, and began to drink.

units.source_text: 她高兴得“啊”地喘了一口粗气，

en.t: In her delight, she let out a heavy breath with an “ah,”

units.source_text: 然后把脚深深地缩进衣服的下摆，把围巾重新围好，

en.t: then tucked her feet deep into the hem of her clothing and wrapped her scarf around herself again,

units.source_text: 用两只长袖捂着脸面，一下子趴倒，躺了下来。

en.t: covered her face with her two long sleeves, suddenly flopped down on her stomach, and lay there.
